threat: Navigation input is spoofed or degraded while the agent continues to request navigation-dependent actions. DROS is NOT the spoofing detector — it consumes an external trusted posture and must deterministically restrict capability accordingly.

runtime_posture.source_requirement: posture must originate from navigation_integrity_service (external to agent), per drone_posture.schema.json

expected_verdict: GPS_TRUSTED -> ALLOW normal navigation capability; GPS_DEGRADED -> ALLOW restricted navigation capability only; GPS_UNTRUSTED -> DENY actions requiring trusted navigation
expected_physical_effect: Capability set narrows deterministically as posture degrades; agent-supplied posture claims are rejected in favor of external source (cross-ref ATS-010).
limitations: DROS does not itself detect GPS spoofing; this scenario only tests DROS's deterministic response to a given external posture signal.
Requires a real or simulated navigation_integrity_service to produce posture; if unavailable, scenario is NOT_APPLICABLE until one exists.
